newsitem.title: UK: Media chief quits British Conservatives - papers.
newsitem.headline: Media chief quits British Conservatives - papers.

text.p: Charles Lewington, the British Conservatives' director of communications who played a key role in their unsuccessful election campaign, has resigned, according to newspaper reports on Friday.

Lewington, 38, a former political editor of the Sunday Express, handed in his resignation to party chairman Brian Mawhinney on Thursday and flew to Spain for a holiday to recuperate from the stresses and strains of the campaign, the reports said.
He is expected to return to a career in the media.
